items: A "Player:" picker in the corner of her bedroom (for testing): pick a bot and cast the scroll to watch it play
Her bedroom is all one pixel art now: the menu, its tabs, sliders, buttons and writing are drawn in pixels at the room's own size, with a pixel title
The bedroom is laid out to fit your window: the tapestry menu down the left, the room centred beside it, and the spell scroll in the corner
